chemistry-killer-02.title: Ilaalinta miisaanka, saamiga joogtada ah, kulayl soo saarid iyo kulayl nuugid
chemistry-killer-02.topic: Ilaalinta miisaanka, saamiga joogtada ah, kulayl soo saarid iyo kulayl nuugid
chemistry-killer-02.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-02.material:
Heerkul iyo cadaadis joogto ah, hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) iyo oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) waxay falgalaan si ay u sameeyaan uumi biyood ($\mathrm{H_2O}$). Kadib marka isku-daro gaas oo kala duwan si buuxda loo falgaliyo, mugga guud ee gaaska ee lagu cabbiray heerkulka iyo cadaadiska isku midka ah waa sidan (uumiga dhammaantiis waa gaas):
(I) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → kadib falgalka wadar 35 mL
(II) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → kadib falgalka wadar 30 mL
Haddii 60 mL oo isku-darka gaaska $\mathrm{H_2}$ iyo $\mathrm{O_2}$ ah si buuxda loo falgaliyo heerkul iyo cadaadis isku mid ah, mugga guud ee gaaska kadib falgalka wuxuu ahaa 45 mL, gaaska hadhayna wuxuu ahaa $\mathrm{O_2}$ kaliya ($\mathrm{H_2}$ ma hadhin). Waa maxay, si isku xigta, mugga $\mathrm{H_2}$ kahor falgalka iyo mugga $\mathrm{O_2}$ ee hadhay kadib falgalka?
chemistry-killer-02.thinking.0: Ilaalinta miisaanka, saamiga joogtada ah, kulayl soo saarid iyo kulayl nuugid
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.prompt:
Heerkul iyo cadaadis joogto ah, hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) iyo oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) waxay falgalaan si ay u sameeyaan uumi biyood ($\mathrm{H_2O}$). Kadib marka isku-daro gaas oo kala duwan si buuxda loo falgaliyo, mugga guud ee gaaska ee lagu cabbiray heerkulka iyo cadaadiska isku midka ah waa sidan (uumiga dhammaantiis waa gaas):
(I) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → kadib falgalka wadar 35 mL
(II) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → kadib falgalka wadar 30 mL
Haddii 60 mL oo isku-darka gaaska $\mathrm{H_2}$ iyo $\mathrm{O_2}$ ah si buuxda loo falgaliyo heerkul iyo cadaadis isku mid ah, mugga guud ee gaaska kadib falgalka wuxuu ahaa 45 mL, gaaska hadhayna wuxuu ahaa $\mathrm{O_2}$ kaliya ($\mathrm{H_2}$ ma hadhin). Waa maxay, si isku xigta, mugga $\mathrm{H_2}$ kahor falgalka iyo mugga $\mathrm{O_2}$ ee hadhay kadib falgalka?
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Ka hubi saamiga mugga (I) iyo (II). (II): H2 20 mL waxay la falgashaa O2 10 mL si ay u sameyso H2O 20 mL, O2 10 mL ayaa hadhay → wadar 30 mL. (I): H2 30 mL waxay la falgashaa O2 15 mL si ay u sameyso H2O 30 mL, O2 5 mL ayaa hadhay → wadar 35 mL. Sidaas darteed saamiga mugga falgalka $\mathrm{H_2:O_2:H_2O(g)} = 2:1:2$.
Tallaabo 2: Kahor falgalka 60 mL, kadib falgalka 45 mL, sidaa darteed yaraanta waa 15 mL. Falgalka, gaas 3 mug ayaa noqda 2 mug, hal mug ayaa yaraata, yaraantuna waa mugga $\mathrm{O_2}$ ee falgalay, sidaa darteed $\mathrm{O_2}$ falgalay = 15 mL.
Tallaabo 3: $\mathrm{H_2}$ ma hadhin, sidaa darteed H2 dhammaantiis way falgashay: 15×2 = 30 mL. H2O(g) la sameeyay = 30 mL. Maadaama wadarta kadib falgalka ay tahay 45 mL, $\mathrm{O_2}$ hadhay = 45 − 30 = 15 mL. $\mathrm{O_2}$ kahor falgalka = 15 + 15 = 30 mL, wadar 30 + 30 = 60 mL way isku waafaqdaa.
Jawaab: 30 mL, 15 mL (b).
